title: The Bogle-Chandler Case: Why Did a Scientist and His Mistress Die Beside a River?
description:
On New Year's Day 1963, physicist Dr. Gilbert Bogle and Margaret Chandler were found dead on a Sydney riverbank with no visible wounds or weapons. Despite extensive testing, no known poison was detected, and an unidentified substance found in Bogle's stomach was never identified, leading to an open coroner's finding.

The case grew stranger as Bogle's classified optics research drew intelligence agencies into the investigation, files vanished, and theories ranged from mushroom poisoning to LSD exposure. Recent research points to hydrogen sulfide gas from the polluted river as a possible cause—but the official files remain sealed, leaving this 60-year-old mystery officially unsolved. Subscribe now 👇
